content:
Alex M.: Heads-up: ACME partner connector is emitting an extra epoch_start that's misaligned to our hourly windows — we see 15m offsets leading to overlapping windows and double-counts in some invoices. Seen on SI connector v2.2.1.
Maria P.: Which connector build and which customers hit? @Sanjay K.? :thinking_face: 
Sanjay K.: ACME SI v2.2.1, customers in EU region mainly. Sample payload: ```{
  "usage_ts": 1680000123,
  "epoch_start": 1680000000,
  "units": 10,
  "plan_field": "quota_plan_v2"
}``` They are flooring to 900s (15m) instead of 3600s for hourly reports. That creates overlap when we roll hourly buckets.
Jess (Partner Eng): Looks like their aggregator anchors to local hour boundaries then converts to UTC without adjusting the floor. Also some legacy appliances send local epoch_start with DST offsets. We'll ask ACME for a patch.
Alex M.: Impact: duplicates ~2% of affected hourly windows; entitlements show higher consumed for a subset. We need quick mitigation + reconciliation plan.
Maria P.: Short term mitigation idea: on Redwood ingest for marketplace paths flagged as hourly, drop events where epoch_start % 3600 != 0 and log them to an audit table for backfill. Also notify partner to stop sending non-aligned windows.
Jess (Partner Eng): ACME will change aggregator to emit canonical "window_start" in UTC aligned to 3600s. They estimate a 48h ETA for patch rollout. We'll get example payloads and test vectors.
Sanjay K.: For robust reconciliation, implement ledger-side dedupe by fingerprint: sha256(customer_id + ':' + window_start + ':' + sku). Deduplicate within a 24h ingest window. Can be toggled per-partner. Thoughts?
Alex M.: Agree. Feature-flagged dedupe per partner is safest. @Platform Ops, can infra flip a flag for partner=acme?
Platform Ops Bot: FLAG_REQUEST created: FLAGS-987-partner-acme-dedupe; owner assigned to infra-team; target rollout: 2 hours after approval.
Jess (Partner Eng): Also note mapping nuance: ACME uses "quota_plan_v2" but a small fraction still send legacy "plan" string. We'll include normalization in the patch to avoid entitlement mapping misses.
Maria P.: Action items -> 1) infra: enable dedupe flag for ACME (Sanjay to validate) 2) partners-eng (Jess): send hotfix ask + example payloads and unit tests to ACME 3) infra/eng (Alex): run backfill dedupe job and reconcile ledger for affected windows 4) ops (Maria): create postmortem if mismatch >5% and notify billing ops.
Alex M.: I'll start the backfill query tomorrow 07:00 UTC and share the results in this thread. Tagging for visibility: partners and billing ops.
Jess (Partner Eng): I'll draft the partner communication now and include test vectors and a spec: field name -> "window_start_utc_epoch" and requirement: aligned to 3600s.
Sanjay K.: I'll add dedupe logic to the ingest pipeline with a feature flag and a small retention tombstone for 24h. Will post PR link when ready.
Maria P.: Thanks all — please update the thread with PRs, partner responses, and backfill results so we can close out after reconciliation.
